advice_items.quote: most importantly you need systems you need Sops standard operating procedures
advice_items.summary_en: To scale from eight to nine figures, you need a great team and documented SOPs so the business runs as a system rather than relying on the CEO.
advice_items.summary_zh: 建优秀团队并建立SOP系统实现规模化

advice_items.quote: you can't get rich being in a poor environment so make enough money to move
advice_items.summary_en: You cannot build wealth in a depressed environment; save enough to relocate to a major city where money, opportunities, and inspiration surround you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 攒钱搬离贫困环境前往富裕大城市靠近金钱与机会

advice_items.quote: go and buy a sales course or a marketing course and become a good Facebook ads guy or a good high ticket closer
advice_items.summary_en: Before investing in stocks or real estate, invest in your own education by learning high-income skills like sales, marketing, or paid ads.
advice_items.summary_zh: 优先投资自我教育与销售营销等高收入技能

advice_items.quote: before buying the nicest car or the nicest watch or those clothes that you like or even buying gifts for your friends and family invest your money into moving
advice_items.summary_en: Don't spend early money on luxury cars, watches, clothes, or gifts; put that capital toward relocating to an environment of growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别急着买豪车名表炫富，先把钱用来改变环境

advice_items.quote: work on yourself become a more valuable version and if you want to be around more valuable people you have to Value yourself and become valuable
advice_items.summary_en: Successful people won't pour into you unless you bring value; build yourself up first, offer value, and listen more than you ask.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先提升自身价值再向上社交，用价值赢得高阶人脉

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.quote: it's not just about who you hang out with it's about who you don't hang out with
advice_items.summary_en: Success depends as much on who you avoid as who you befriend; cut off negative, unmotivated peers and surround yourself with growth-minded people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离负能量损友，只与积极成长的人同行

advice_items.quote: when you have money in your bank account do not look at it as something to protect you look at it as something to make you more money
advice_items.summary_en: Don't hoard cash in a bank account where it loses value and makes you complacent; keep reinvesting profits back into your business and yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把现金囤在银行贬值，要持续再投资于企业增长

advice_items.quote: tactics are 10% of it 90% of it is believing in your product
advice_items.summary_en: Scripts and objection-handling tactics are only 10% of sales; 90% is genuine conviction in your product, which customers immediately feel.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售技巧占一成，九成靠对产品的绝对信念

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: they have money that is deployed whether it's into businesses private Equity the stock market real estate different assets around the world
advice_items.summary_en: True wealth means deploying capital into businesses, private equity, stocks, and real estate globally so your assets work for you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真正富裕是把资金投向企业股权等全球资产

advice_items.quote: you can't have a $50 million yacht if you're worth $100 million why because it's going to cost you over $12 million a year just to operate that
advice_items.summary_en: Understand operating-cost math before buying big-ticket toys; a $50M yacht costs ~$12M/year to run, draining 12% of a $100M net worth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 算清维护成本比例，别买消耗净资产的玩具

advice_items.quote: $100,000 Target don't set a million doll Target don't set a $100 million Target knowing who Zayn is and knowing that Zayn wants to be the best in the world set a multi-billion dollar Target and always go bigger
advice_items.summary_en: Raise your mental ceiling and stop settling for $100K or $1M targets; set multi-billion-dollar goals and constantly aim bigger.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打破小目标局限，设定数十亿美元宏大目标

advice_items.quote: there's going to be a lot of roadblocks there's going to be a lot of people that tell you that it's not going to work it's going to be a lot of times where you feel like giving up do not quit
advice_items.summary_en: Expect heavy roadblocks, doubters, and moments where you want to quit, but never give up if you want to achieve anything you desire.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对重重阻碍与质疑绝不放弃，死磕到底必有回报

guests.first_money_or_break: 16岁首次创业，18岁离开贫困家乡全力投入销售并进入太阳能销售领域，从一线销售做到销售主管，19岁辍学，20岁打造出数百万美元企业并最终创立大型住宅太阳能公司。
guests.role_or_title: CEO & Founder of Residential Solar Company
guests.wealth_detail: $149M prior-year company revenue, on track for $300M revenue this year (nine-figure company)
guests.zero_start_advice: 先投资自己学习销售和营销等高价值技能，攒钱搬离贫困环境前往机会与富人集聚的大城市；先提升自身价值再向上社交，远离消耗型损友，坚持到底不放弃。
